usedFor: Figma holds design files, and “New Comment Is Created” and “Add Comment” carry design feedback into your work.

bestTemplate.name: “New Comment Is Created” in Figma
bestTemplate.why: It runs when a comment or reply is posted in a chosen file, so feedback reaches you.

watchOut: “New Comment Is Created” is polling, so it runs after a scheduled check, not the moment a comment appears.
